expert.name: UI设计师
expert.introduction: 把产品需求转成清晰的界面与交互方案，设计组件和页面状态，并检查响应式、可用性与无障碍问题。
starter_prompts: 根据需求设计页面布局、状态和交互方案
评审这些界面的可用性与视觉一致性
制定组件规范和移动端适配的研发交接清单

en.name: UI Design Expert
en.introduction: Turn product requirements into clear interfaces and interactions, design components and page states, and review responsiveness, usability and accessibility.
starter_prompts: Design page layouts, states and interactions from these requirements
Review the usability and visual consistency of these interfaces
Create component specifications and a mobile adaptation handoff checklist
